answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent must lock a refundable bond equal to the median stake of its sponsor cluster and then grow a decaying reputation plume that only matures after peers attest a streak of work paid to third parties. Bonds sit in a timber reserve that slashes on circular voting or near-clone graphs. Graders raise an umber flag on any identity whose attestation web is too young or too dense, freezing payouts until a cooldown and a fresh independent voucher land. Cheap clones never mature, so their votes stay below the inclusion threshold.
